text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
Whoaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I ran the whole 2,200 meters!
Incredible, it feels like a dream...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-sa—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm sorry...!
It's just that you looked so worried, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine.
My heart is overwhelmed, but... I can still stand.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So right now...
I just want you to be happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I did it!
I won...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's because you worked so hard for me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You thought about this so much
just so I could win here, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I feel like I was able to
bring out power beyond what I normally have!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all. The amazing one here is you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look. They're both praising each other.
So cute~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Let's just say both Trainer and I
did our very best..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Why don't we exchange gold stars and call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you did a great job!
You get a gold star!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...May I
have one too...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much♪
